title: 「As far as I know, …」據我所知……
titleZh: 「As far as I know, …」據我所知……
titleEn: Using “As far as I know” to qualify information

source.file: Sentence Structure 269 -「As far as I know, …」據我所知…….pdf
omissions: Every numbered Important Rule and Benefit is retained as a separate Chinese-primary card. Where the PDF has no complete English counterpart, the English explanation is a faithful editorial translation.
The source filename is numbered 269; it is assigned system ID ss270 because the source set contains two distinct PDFs labelled 201.

formula: as far as + subject + know(s) / knew

formulas.formula: As far as + subject + know(s), + main clause
Main clause, + as far as + subject + know(s)
Main clause with as far as + subject + know(s) between commas

example: As far as I know, no final decision has been made.
exampleZh: 據我所知，現時尚未作出最後決定。

examples.en: As far as I know, no final decision has been made.
examples.zh: 據我所知，現時尚未作出最後決定。
examples.highlight: As far as I know, no final decision has been made.

meaning.zh: 這個句型表示說法是根據某人目前或當時掌握的資料作出，但說話者不保證自己知道所有情況。

rules.zh: 核心表達並不一定要放在句首 最常見的形式是： As far as I know, the office is still open. 但以下兩種寫法同樣正確： The office is still open, as far as I know. The office is, as far as I know, still open. 因此，句首位置只是其中一種用法，不是固定位置。
rules.en: The expression is not restricted to the beginning. It can appear initially, finally or between commas within the main clause.

rules.zh: 不要在 know 後面加 that 正確： As far as I know, the meeting is still on. 錯誤： As far as I know that the meeting is still on. 完整的 as far as I know 已經是一個插入表達，後面直接接主要句子。
rules.en: Do not add that after know. “As far as I know” is a complete parenthetical expression and is followed directly by the main clause.

rules.zh: 動詞要配合主語 I / you / we / they / plural noun + know As far as we know, the road is clear. As far as the organisers know, every speaker has confirmed. he / she / singular noun + knows As far as she knows, the course begins in September. As far as the manager knows, no complaint has been received. 過去時間統一使用 knew： As far as they knew, the documents were safe.
rules.en: Make know agree with its subject: I, you, we, they and plural nouns take know; he, she and singular nouns take knows; past contexts take knew.

rules.zh: 放在句中時，前後通常使用逗號 The manager has not, as far as I know, approved the request. The keys are, as far as the caretaker knows, in the office. 句中的部分屬於補充說明，因此通常要用兩個逗號把它分隔開。
rules.en: When the expression is inserted inside the main clause, normally set it off with a comma on each side.

rules.zh: 這個句型表示「有限度的認知」，不是絕對肯定 The office is closed. （辦公室已經關閉。） 這句聽起來像一項確定的事實。 As far as I know, the office is closed. （據我所知，辦公室已經關閉。） 這句表示：根據我掌握的資料，辦公室已經關閉，但我可能沒有最新或完整資料。
rules.en: The expression marks limited knowledge rather than absolute certainty. It shows that the information may not be complete or fully up to date.

rules.zh: 和 As far as I am concerned 不同 As far as I know 表示根據自己掌握的資料。 As far as I know, the plan is still being reviewed. （據我所知，這項計劃仍在審議中。） As far as I am concerned 表示個人意見或立場。 As far as I am concerned, the plan is too expensive. （依我看來，這項計劃太昂貴。） 簡單分辨： ● As far as I know = 我所知道的資料 ● As far as I am concerned = 我的個人看法
rules.en: Do not confuse “As far as I know”, which refers to available information, with “As far as I am concerned”, which introduces a personal opinion or position.

rules.zh: 相關表達不是本練習的固定句型 以下說法意思相近，但不屬於本練習要求的核心形式： As far as I can tell, … （就我判斷……） As far as I am aware, … （據我所知……） To the best of my knowledge, … （據我所知……） 本練習的核心表達是： as far as + subject + know(s) / knew
rules.en: Related expressions such as “As far as I can tell”, “As far as I am aware” and “To the best of my knowledge” are not the fixed target form in this exercise.

benefits.zh: 資料未必完整時，可以更誠實地表達 你可以說明自己是根據現有資料作答，而不是假裝完全肯定。 As far as I know, the train is still running. （據我所知，火車仍然行駛。）
benefits.en: It helps you speak honestly when the information available to you may be incomplete.

benefits.zh: 避免把未確認的資料說成絕對事實 直接說： The event has been cancelled. 會令人以為你完全肯定活動已經取消。 改為： As far as I know, the event has been cancelled. 便能清楚表示這只是根據你目前掌握的資料。
benefits.en: It prevents an unconfirmed statement from sounding like an absolute fact.

benefits.zh: 適合用來交代最新情況 當你談論會議、交通、工作安排、調查或仍在發展中的事件時，資料可能隨時改變。這個句型能讓 你在提供實用資訊的同時，保留適當的謹慎。
benefits.en: It is useful for updates about meetings, transport, work arrangements, investigations and other developing situations.

benefits.zh: 令糾正或不同意見聽起來較有禮貌 直接說： You are wrong. The office opens at nine. 語氣可能過於強硬。 較自然的說法是： As far as I know, the office opens at nine. （據我所知，辦公室在九時開門。） 你仍然提出不同資料，但不會直接指責對方錯誤。
benefits.en: It can make corrections and disagreements sound less aggressive by presenting different information cautiously.

benefits.zh: 增加句式變化 你可以把這個表達放在句首、句中或句尾，因此不需要每次都使用相同的句子開頭。 As far as I know, the plan has not changed. The plan has not changed, as far as I know. The plan has not, as far as I know, changed.
benefits.en: It provides natural variation because the expression can appear at the beginning, in the middle or at the end.

en: Rewrite each sentence using as far as + subject + know(s) / knew.
The expression may appear at the beginning, in the middle or at the end; follow the supplied first word and preserve the original time reference.
zh: 使用 as far as + 主語 + know(s) / knew 改寫每題。
這個表達可放在句首、句中或句尾；按照已提供的第一個字作答，並保留原句的時間意思。
